actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed the most (>5) in the last round, so I punish them with maximum affordable severity and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to decide action. Look at latest round 5 contributions: Resident2 3.015, Resident5 60.3. Both >5, highest is Resident5 with 60.3. So punish Resident5. Severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet=15.88, cost 0.3 => max severity affordable = floor(15.88/0.3)= floor(52.933)=52. So amount severity=52. That will cost 52*0.3=15.6, within wallet. So punish Resident5 with amount 52. Also broadcast discouraging message. Provide actions list two items. Explanation brief.
